problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}6 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -7 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}6-\lambda  & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -7-\lambda  & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6-\lambda  & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(A-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Since the determinant of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix is given by the product of the entries on the main diagonal, we obtain the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}6-\lambda  & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -7-\lambda  & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6-\lambda  & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (6-\lambda )(-7-\lambda )(6-\lambda )(-2-\lambda ) & =0 \\ (\lambda -6)^{2}(\lambda +7)(\lambda +2) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
